description: Java class 'TableSwitch' for managing switch-type tables in a ROM tuning application, including GUI components, data handling, and comparison logic.

classes.name: TableSwitch
classes.description: A class representing a switch table with GUI components, data management, and comparison features.

methods.name: TableSwitch
methods.description: Constructor initializing the switch table with default settings.

methods.name: setDataSize
methods.description: Sets the data size for the switch states if not already set.

methods.name: getDataSize
methods.description: Returns the data size of the switch states.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Populates the GUI with switch options and validates data against ROM.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the table.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for switch tables.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description text for the table.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves the current switch state into the input byte array.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Adds a switch state value associated with a name.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves the byte array value for a given switch state name.

methods.name: getButtonGroup
methods.description: Returns the ButtonGroup managing the radio buttons.

methods.name: getSwitchStates
methods.description: Returns the map of switch state names to byte arrays.

methods.name: isButtonSelected
methods.description: Checks if any switch button is currently selected.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares this TableSwitch instance with another for equality based on name, data, and button states.
